::: notes
- Today: what to do when a data set has far more rows than the screen has pixels.
- The road: the problem → a framework (bin, summarize, smooth, plot) → datashader, the
  framework at pixel resolution → live on 300 million people → where aggregation runs
  for interactivity → tools → pitfalls.
- Most of the census part runs live: questions and "what if we change this?" welcome.
:::
